text:
anjali: customer reporting a billing surprise — invoice shows ~3.2k tokens but their SDK estimator reports ~1.1k. they say the payload is a single user prompt + short assistant reply, no tool calls. :eyes:
eli: thanks. can you paste a minimal repro (curl or SDK) and the invoice ids? also include the request-id header if available.
anjali: invoice IDs 98765-2026 and 98766-2026. minimal curl they used:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-3.1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are helpful."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this text: ..."}]}'
```
anjali: customer insists there were no function calls. they also used the official JS SDK estimator which returned ~1100 tokens. invoice much higher.
tom: quick sanity check — can you re-run with streaming disabled and add a debug header so the runtime echoes the metering delta? e.g. `-H "x-redwood-debug: meter-echo=1"`
anjali: re-ran with that header, got this small server note in the response meta:```
{"metering_debug":{"counted_tokens":3218,"client_estimate":1142,"server_injected_prefill_tokens":2066}}
```
sasha: that pattern matches a few recent reports — runtime is injecting a hidden prefill that contains function/tool wrapper tokens + KV metadata for sidecars. SDK estimators only run on the user-visible message array, so they miss server-inserted assistant/tool prefill.
meter-bot: metering record found for req_id=req-0a1b2c — billed_tokens=3218, estimator_tokens=1142, reason_tags=["server_prefill","kv-meta","postrun"]
tom: root cause hypothesis: the model emitted a `function_call` in an earlier partial, the runtime expanded/merged the tool output into a hidden assistant->tool chunk that gets counted for billing but is not present in SDK message list used by local estimate. also we add small JSON wrapper metadata (session KV) that is counted as tokens.
eli: can you paste the streaming vs non-streaming diff? is this reproducible with a single non-streaming call?
tom: reproduced with non-streaming run. minimal repro steps: 1) call chat completion with a prompt that triggers a short `function_call` (simulate with a stub function), 2) include `x-redwood-debug: meter-echo=1`, 3) check `metering_debug.server_injected_prefill_tokens` in response. example:```json
{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Call weather() for Boston"}],"functions":[{"name":"weather","parameters":{}}]}
```
anjali: next steps: 1) explain to customer that SDK was estimating visible messages only and server-injected tokens (tool responses, KV wrappers) are billed; 2) provide repro and the `meter-echo` header for them to verify; 3) create internal ticket to consider opt-in SDK flag to include server-prefill tokens in estimates.
eli: created SUP-4821 and assigned to devex (adding tom). ETA for doc + short KB note: 48 hours. :white_check_mark:
tom: short-term: add a note in the support reply template explaining hidden server-prefill tokens (function/tool outputs, postrun metadata, KV blobs) and attach the metering debug snippet.
sasha: longer-term: devex to evaluate exposing a debug API that returns the fully concatenated tokenized payload so customers can match invoice counts.
anjali: I will send the customer the explanations + sample curl with `x-redwood-debug: meter-echo=1` and keep this thread updated. closing loop here — marking as needs follow-up.
eli: thanks team — please add any more logs to SUP-4821.
